dating.title: Online Dating, Reimagined for a Global World
dating.subtitle: FioreMatch is built for people who don't want their dating pool limited by a border, a language, or a stale algorithm.
dating.intro: Whether you're looking for a relationship, something casual, or new people to build a life around, FioreMatch gives you real filters, an AI matching layer that explains itself, and a safety team that actually reviews reports — not just a swipe deck.
filters: Relationship intent — casual, dating, long-term, friendship

international.title: International Dating Without the Guesswork
international.subtitle: Cross-border relationships are harder to fake and easier to get wrong. FioreMatch is designed around that reality.
international.body1: International dating fails for predictable reasons: language gaps, mismatched expectations about intent, timezone friction, and — too often — scams targeting people who feel far from home. FioreMatch's architecture treats translation, verification signals, and honest intent-setting as core features, not afterthoughts.
international.body2: Every profile states relationship intent and spoken languages up front. Our moderation systems are tuned specifically for cross-border scam patterns — romance scams, fake military or overseas-worker personas, and urgent money requests — so you can focus on getting to know someone real.
international.tipsTitle: Dating across a border, done well
tips: Video call before you get emotionally invested — always.
Never send money, gift cards, or crypto to someone you haven't met in person.
Use in-app messaging until real trust is established.
Report anything that feels like a script, not a conversation.

matching.title: How FioreMatch matching actually works
matching.subtitle: Don't swipe forever. Meet people who actually fit you.
matching.intro: Most dating apps optimise for how long you keep swiping. FioreMatch optimises for how quickly you find someone worth talking to. Here is exactly how our matching works — no black box, no mystique.
matching.matchmakerBody: Describe what you're looking for in your own words — "someone who wants a long-term relationship, loves travelling and speaks English" — and FioreMatch turns it into structured search criteria. The AI can only pick from a fixed vocabulary of goals, interests, languages and cultures, and every criterion is validated before it reaches the matching engine. It cannot invent a requirement you didn't ask for.
matching.dnaBody: A short, light quiz plus your profile builds a picture across three plain signals: lifestyle, communication style, and interests. This is not a personality test and produces no psychological label about you. Results are always framed as potential compatibility, never as a scientific verdict.
matching.fiveBody: Each day you get up to five strong suggestions — and deliberately fewer when fewer genuinely good matches exist. Padding the list with weak profiles would defeat the point.
matching.reasonsBody: Each suggestion carries a "Why you may match" list built only from data we actually hold — a shared relationship goal, a language you both speak, an interest you both listed. If we can't back a reason with a real shared value, we don't show it.
reasonsExample: You both speak English and Spanish
Both interested in travel and photography
Both open to meeting people from other cultures
matching.signalsBody: The matching engine blends these signals, weighted differently in each discovery mode. Anything we don't have data for is treated as unknown — never as agreement.
signals: Location, distance, and future location plans
matching.notScoredBody: The matching engine is only ever given the fields listed above. It never receives — and cannot infer from — ethnicity, religion, health, political views, or income. Cultural interest means what you want to connect with, never an assumption based on where you're from.
matching.learningTitle: It learns only from what you tell it
matching.learningBody: When you pass on someone, you can optionally say why. That feedback nudges how we weight a signal for you, within strict caps, and decays back toward neutral over time so your suggestions keep widening again. We don't infer preferences from how long you looked at a photo.

globalMatch.title: Global Match
globalMatch.subtitle: Meet beyond borders — on purpose, not by accident.
globalMatch.intro: Most apps treat distance as a single slider. FioreMatch treats how you want to connect as a first-class choice, with six discovery modes that each surface something different.

modes.name: Local
modes.desc: People near you, with distance weighted heaviest.

modes.name: Country
modes.desc: Anyone in your country, distance still matters but less.

modes.name: Global
modes.desc: Worldwide, ranked on shared language and interests instead of proximity.

modes.name: Culture
modes.desc: People who share your cultural interests, or are open to yours.

modes.name: Language
modes.desc: Language exchange — you teach yours, they teach theirs.

modes.name: Travel
modes.desc: People whose travel plans overlap with yours, or who live where you're heading.

globalMatch.reachBody: My city · My country · Nearby countries · Worldwide · Specific countries. You choose, and you can change it whenever you like.
globalMatch.cultureBody: Pick the cultures you're genuinely curious about, and optionally flag that you'd like to meet people interested in other cultures. This is about shared curiosity — FioreMatch never treats someone's nationality as a personality trait or infers their culture from where they live.
globalMatch.languageBody: Say what you speak and what you're learning. When your languages complement someone else's — you speak Turkish and want Spanish, they speak Spanish and want Turkish — that mutual fit is scored highly. You can use FioreMatch for dating, language exchange, or both.
globalMatch.travelBody: Add a trip — destination, dates, and what you're into — and we can prioritise people who'll be there at the same time, or who already live there. Moving to a new city in six months? Say so, and start meeting people before you arrive. Both are optional, and you control who can see them.
globalMatch.privacyBody: Location, travel plans, future location, languages, cultural interests, and relationship goal each have their own visibility setting: everyone, matches only, or hidden. Hidden fields are stripped before matching even reads them, so they cannot influence your suggestions or leak through a bug. We never show a precise address.

safetyV2.shieldBody: FioreMatch watches for the patterns that romance scams actually use — money requests, crypto and investment steering, shortened links, pressure to move to another app within minutes of matching, and the same message blasted at many people at once.
safetyV2.shieldFlowTitle: What happens when something is detected

shieldFlow.desc: You see a plain-language caution telling you exactly what we noticed, so you can judge for yourself.
Reporting is made prominent rather than buried, if you decide something is wrong.
Higher-risk cases go to a trained moderator — not to an automated decision.
Any enforcement follows a human's decision. It is never the automatic result of a detection.

safetyV2.shieldNoteTitle: What Scam Shield will not do
safetyV2.shieldNote: It will never label someone a scammer automatically, and detection alone never bans an account. Detection is lexical and behavioural only — we never treat someone's nationality, name, language, or photo as a risk signal. We deliberately under-flag: wrongly accusing a real member does more damage than a borderline case that the report flow still catches.
safetyV2.trustBody: Profiles show which verifications a member has completed — email, phone, photo, liveness, or identity. Each badge confirms one specific check passed. There is no overall safety score, and we never claim any member is guaranteed to be safe: verification confirms a fact, not a person's intentions. Members without badges are not marked suspicious — an absent badge just means an absent check.
safetyV2.dateBody: Planning to meet someone? Record who, when, and where, and optionally share those details with one person you trust. You can mark a date as started and completed yourself.
safetyV2.dateDisclaimer: Date Safety Mode records a plan and can notify a contact you chose. FioreMatch is not an emergency service: it does not monitor you and cannot respond to an incident. If you're in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.

conversation.title: The first message, made easier
conversation.subtitle: The hardest part of dating apps is the blank text box. These tools help — they never take over.
conversation.icebreakerBody: When you match, FioreMatch finds what you genuinely have in common and suggests an opener based on it. "You both love travelling — what's the best place you've ever been?" Categories span friendly, funny, romantic, travel, culture, food, and hobbies.
conversation.coachBody: Stuck mid-conversation? Ask for help and get an open-ended question, a follow-up, a topic suggestion, or a reply idea. You pick what to send, edit it however you like, or ignore it entirely.
conversation.gamesBody: Optional mini-games to break the ice: This or That, Would You Rather, Two Truths and a Lie, Quick Questions, and Guess My Answer.
conversation.translationBody: Message across languages, with a one-tap toggle between the translated text and the original — so you can always see exactly what was written. Translation is there to carry meaning across, not to change it.
conversation.boundaryBody: AI on FioreMatch suggests; it never acts as you. It will not send messages on your behalf, will not carry on a romantic conversation in your place, and will not pretend to be a person. Every message that goes out is one you chose to send.

games.title: Match Games
games.subtitle: Optional mini-games that make the first conversation easier.
games.fairPlay: Neither of you can see the other's answer until you've both answered — enforced by the server, not by trusting the app.
games.optional: Games are always optional. Either of you can skip an invite or end a game at any point, and declining is a perfectly normal answer.

list.name: This or That
list.desc: Quick either/or picks. Coffee or tea, plan everything or improvise.

list.name: Would You Rather
list.desc: Two tempting options, no easy answer. A fast way to find out how someone thinks.

list.name: Two Truths and a Lie
list.desc: Write three statements, one false. Your match guesses which — and the lie stays hidden until they do.

list.name: Quick Questions
list.desc: Short open questions: best trip, comfort food, the song you have on repeat.

list.name: Guess My Answer
list.desc: Guess what your match would say, then compare. Usually the funniest of the five.

referral.fairTitle: Why rewards unlock later, not instantly
referral.fairBody: Paying out the moment someone signs up is exactly what makes referral programmes worth gaming. Rewards unlock once your friend has verified their email and phone, completed a profile, and actually used FioreMatch for a few days. It's slower, and it's the reason the rewards can stay generous.
referral.abuseBody: Referring yourself, creating accounts to farm rewards, or trading codes in bulk. Suspicious referrals are held for human review rather than auto-penalised — sharing your link somewhere popular is not abuse, and we'd rather ask than wrongly punish you.
